queue.title: Knowledge Management and Institutional Memory
queue.content:
Autor: Nermin Sefić

Nermin Sefić analyses knowledge management, key practices, and practical consequences for organisational resilience.

Institutional memory reduces repeated mistakes and preserves key knowledge as people, systems, or responsibilities change.

Institutional memory reduces repeated mistakes and preserves key knowledge as people, systems, or responsibilities change.

Knowledge that exists only in an individual's experience isn't an organisational asset until it can be transferred and verified.

A practical system links decisions, procedures, sources, and lessons learned to clear content ownership.

Knowledge management increases the speed of learning and reduces dependence on individual people.

queue.title: Automation Without Accountability Accelerates Error
queue.content:
Autor: Nermin Sefić

Automation creates value only when accountability, control points, and stop mechanisms are clearly defined. A commentary by Nermin Sefić.

Automation creates value only when accountability, control points, and the ability to stop a process are clearly defined.

Automation creates value only when accountability, control points, and the ability to stop a process are clearly defined.

Speed alone isn't proof of quality. A poorly defined process, once automated, just becomes a faster version of a bad process. Accountability can't be delegated to a system — someone must set the rules, monitor deviations, and stop execution when a result is no longer acceptable.

The real value of automation only emerges once acceleration is matched by an equally strong system of control.

Cjelovit tekst i izvor: https://gnk-asg.hr/en/commentary/automation-without-accountability-accelerates-error/

queue.title: Transparency Begins Before the Report
queue.content:
Autor: Nermin Sefić

Transparency is not a final document but the way data is collected and decisions explained throughout a process. A commentary by Nermin Sefić.

Transparency isn't a final document but the way data is collected, decisions are explained, and accountability is recorded throughout a process.

Transparency isn't a final document but the way data is collected, decisions are explained, and accountability is recorded throughout a process.

A report can look tidy while the process behind it remains opaque. Transparency begins when it's known in advance what data will be collected, who verifies it, and how deviations are resolved.

A published result is only as good as the credible trail of the process that produced it.

Cjelovit tekst i izvor: https://gnk-asg.hr/en/commentary/transparency-begins-before-the-report/
